part.text:
Fixed abstract Unix socket handling in:

- `tokio/src/net/unix/listener.rs`
- `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs`

Both now strip the leading `\0` marker before calling `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, which expects only the abstract socket name. This prevents the extra NUL byte in the kernel socket address.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-tokio-rs__tokio-6838-9ad2f399 sh -lc \
  'cd /testbed && PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH cargo test -p tokio --features full --test uds_stream abstract_socket_name'
```
